lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three to four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the pectoral fin, arranged in a structured grid that expands in inter-blob distance toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at 90-degree angles, forming high-contrast anchor nodes at each intersection point.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition from high-intensity white along the ridge crest to low-intensity shadow immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of small-diameter high-luminance spots localized on the dorsal surface and leading edge of the left pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger-scale grid pattern on the flank.
